title: HPM5301 clock tree
source: HPMicro HPM SDK v1.13 register definitions and clock drivers (PLLCTLV2, SYSCTL, PCFG)

nodes.label: XTAL24M 24 MHz
nodes.tooltip: 24 MHz crystal. Started by the core when a PLL references it; without a crystal the PLLs fall back to IRC24M.

nodes.label: PLL0 (x MFI)
nodes.tooltip: PLL output = 24 MHz x MFI (MFN = 0), 384-1008 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL1 (x MFI)
nodes.tooltip: PLL output = 24 MHz x MFI (MFN = 0), 384-1008 MHz.

constraints.message: CPU0 above 360 MHz needs a DCDC voltage of at least 1275 mV (HPM SDK hpm5300evk setting for 480 MHz)
